stops.title: Mmaeɛ amanneɛbɔ
stops.caption: Nnawɔtwe biara, asɔre baa biara.
stops.speech: Mmaeɛ amanneɛbɔ kyerɛ nkyerɛwee nnawɔtwe biara ne nnipa soronko dodoɔ, na ɛpae nnipa korɔ a wɔba pii ne nnipa pii a wɔba mu.

stops.title: Hwan na ɔnni hɔ
stops.caption: Wɔahyehyɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛkyɛreeɛ.
stops.speech: Wɔn a wɔnni hɔ nhwɛmu no, wɔde ɔsom dodoɔ a obi amma a ɛdi so ahyehyɛ, na ɛno ne nhwɛmu a ɔhwɛ hia ankasa.
